items: Constitutional amendments and core articles are frequently asked in matching-type questions.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Ultra quick revision consolidates core concepts into digestible summaries for rapid review.
High-yield subjects like Polity, History, and Economy require emphasis on dates, articles, and definitions.
Active recall through flashcards and revision blocks enhances memory consolidation before exam day.
Prioritizing previous years' question trends ensures targeted and effective final-lap preparation.
